repoUrl.description: OPTIONAL. Git URL of the parent/BOM repository (https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>[.git]). Provide this OR owner+repo.

owner.description: OPTIONAL. GitHub owner/org (used when repoUrl is not supplied).

repo.description: OPTIONAL. GitHub repository name (used when repoUrl is not supplied).

pomPath.description: OPTIONAL. Path to the parent/BOM pom.xml within the repo. Defaults to "pom.xml".

branch.description: OPTIONAL. Base branch to read from and target the PR against. Defaults to the repo's default branch.

environment.description: OPTIONAL. Environment label for logging/traceability only; no deployment is performed.

jiraTicketId.description: OPTIONAL. Jira ticket to link; a comment with the PR link is posted when supplied.
